desc: Prove that conversions spanning two or more alphabet positions can be replaced by deletion plus insertion without increasing cost.
For each target frequency \(k\), formulate the binary path DP over whether each letter is selected, with baseline costs and adjacent-transfer savings.
Handle transfer availability for selected versus unselected letters and ensure the final `'z'` surplus is deleted.
Enumerate \(k=1\ldots\max(\text{count})\), include the all-deleted possibility, and establish \(O(26n)\) complexity.
Implement `makeStringGood` and verify the provided examples and edge cases.
